title: Aah Dile Daare Hussain Aye Azadaare Hussain
body:
Aha Dil Daare Hussain...Aye Azadaare Hussain
Aye Sakina Aye Sakina Gule Gulzare Hussain
Ahadar Bepidari Qaidshudi Jaan E Sagheer Be Khata Be Taqseer
Asghamad Nouha Kunad Laashe Alam Daare Hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
Aha Dil Dare Hussain...Aye Azadaare Hussain..
Rasane..Rasane .Zulm Kuja Aaha Kuja Gardan E Tu.
Duraham Bartan E Tu....
Saqt Bardaash Ke Dard E Dil E Zaar E Hussain....
<<DIVIDER>>
Aha Dil Daare Hussain Aey Aza Daare Hussain.......
